scope: E11-B fold-specific pseudo-label teacher; static protocol only
protocol_sha256_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON serialization of this object with protocol_sha256 omitted; sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False
claim_policy: The complete original hyp field is used as one claim; no decomposition or rewriting.

factcg.orientation: Higher means support/Yes: softmax class 1 per reference chunk, then maximum over chunks.

minicheck.orientation: Higher means support: sum of returned top-5 yes-token probabilities, maximum over document chunks; no yes/no renormalization.

hhem.orientation: Higher means supported/consistent with premise; sigmoid of the single raw logit, not hallucination probability.

nli.orientation: Softmax over ordered labels entailment, neutral, contradiction; entailment is support-oriented, contradiction is contradiction-oriented, neutral is neither.

teacher.feature_transform: Raw detector probabilities/scores and exact 0/1 task one-hot only; no inversion, standardization, RF output, or derived feature.
teacher.fit_data: Human-labeled training portion of the corresponding locked outer fold, after text-only cross-fold leakage purge.
teacher.output: predict_proba column corresponding to label_bin=1, p(Hallucination)
teacher.training_metrics: In-sample training metrics only; never validation-fold metrics during pseudo-label generation.

normalization.rule: None -> empty string; list/dict -> JSON with ensure_ascii=False and sorted keys; otherwise str(value); Unicode NFC; trim; collapse every whitespace run to one ASCII space. Do not lowercase or remove punctuation.
normalization.hash_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 normalized parts joined by U+241F

leakage_and_selection.unlabeled_dedup: Keep the lowest original raw row index for each normalized full sample key; assert matching task/reference/hypothesis after dedup.
leakage_and_selection.raw_detector_execution: Run each frozen detector exactly once over deduplicated unlabeled inputs; reuse immutable raw scores for all five folds. No human label enters detector inference.
leakage_and_selection.human_training_purge: For each fold, remove training humans whose normalized hypothesis key or task-reference key equals any held-out human key; no held-out label is read for this comparison. Held-out humans never enter teacher or student training.
leakage_and_selection.unlabeled_fold_purge: Before teacher assignment or student training, remove any deduplicated unlabeled sample matching a held-out human by normalized full sample, hypothesis, task-reference, or task+source+target pair key. Use held-out text/IDs only, never held-out labels.
leakage_and_selection.balancing: Separately for each task DM/MT/PG, n_keep=min(accepted label 1, accepted label 0, 4000); retain n_keep highest p(H) label 1 and n_keep lowest p(H) label 0; break equal-probability ties by ascending sample_key lexicographic order.
leakage_and_selection.provenance_policy: Human label preserved in a separate HUMAN row; PSEUDO rows record fold teacher and p(H). Never overwrite human labels.

freeze_rule: Once pseudo-label generation begins, detector identities, inputs, folds, normalization, leakage purge, teacher configuration, thresholds, balancing, and output semantics may not change based on E11 development results.
